title: Japanese-Style Omelette Bowl
description: A delicious and easy Japanese-inspired breakfast dish made with a fluffy omelette and various toppings, served in a bowl.
instructions: Crack the eggs into a bowl and whisk them together with a fork. Add the youthful and Korean chili flakes, and mix well.
Heat the sesame oil in a small non-stick pan over medium heat.
Pour the egg mixture into the pan and cook until the edges start to set.
Use a spatula to gently lift and fold the edges of the omelette towards the center.
Continue cooking and folding until the omelette is almost set.
Transfer the omelette to a serving bowl.
Drizzle the soy sauce over the omelette.
Sprinkle the green onions and sesame seeds over the top.
